# s358 — Relay contract records a failed review on a started item

**Findings:** s328 and s323 relays 2026-10-17: contract v5 says a failed review is `slicer reject`, but handoff now runs after PASS, so the item is `started` at review time and reject refuses it ("only review work can be rejected") · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** changing `reject`'s status rule, or when handoff runs.

## Why

Contract v5 moved the note and handoff to after `VERDICT: PASS`. Its review step still tells the orchestrator to record a failed review with `slicer reject`, which needs the item in review. Every v1.14 relay with a FAIL round skipped the record, so the item's history no longer shows review failures.

## Files

- `src/slicer/ai.py`: the relay and relay-orchestrator text for a failed review: record it as a `slicer note ID --text "Review FAIL: ..." --render` on the started item (with a `--kind` only when `note_kinds` configures one for reviews), not `reject`.
- `tests/test_ai.py`; `docs/agents.md` if it repeats the step; `CHANGELOG.md`.
